metadata.description: Claude Code mods that hold Claude to accessibility, design-token, quality, secret-handling and privacy rules, plus the ModsPack agents and skills.

plugins.name: wcag-enforcer
plugins.description: Runs jsx-a11y, axe-core and a WCAG 2.2 AA contrast check after each UI edit and feeds failures back to Claude.

plugins.name: design-guardrail
plugins.description: Blocks hardcoded colors and px spacing/font values in UI files and names the design token to use.

plugins.name: qa-gate
plugins.description: Runs lint, type check, spell check and test scripts before Claude finishes a turn that changed code.

plugins.name: secret-scrubber
plugins.description: Redacts keys, tokens, passwords, .env values and private keys from tool output before Claude reads it.

plugins.name: privacy-guard
plugins.description: Blocks Write and Edit calls that add real-looking personal or health data (SSNs, payment cards, IBANs, medical record numbers, named people beside diagnoses), with notes for lower-severity values.

plugins.name: modspack-agents
plugins.description: Six specialist agents (release manager, code reviewer, QA engineer, accessibility auditor, security and privacy auditor, release engineer) and the shared Agent Skills behind them.
